title: Remit-Scout CDK Context Schema
description: Schema for validating CDK context variables

backendImageTag.description: ECR image tag for backend Docker image

sharedSecretArn.description: ARN of the shared Secrets Manager secret used for runtime config (Supabase/Stripe/Redis/etc)

cpuArchitecture.description: CPU architecture for ECS/Lambda where configurable

devNatGateways.description: Dev-only override for number of NAT gateways (0/1). Useful for repairing NAT drift without code changes.

devMinimalInfra.description: Dev-only: deploy a reduced-cost minimal infra footprint focused on Tier-2 B2B observation

planeADbSecretArn.description: ARN of Secrets Manager secret for Plane A database credentials

planeADbSecretJsonKey.description: JSON key in Plane A database secret (e.g., DATABASE_URL_PLANE_A)

planeADbSsmName.description: SSM Parameter Store path for Plane A database URL

planeBDbSecretArn.description: ARN of Secrets Manager secret for Plane B database credentials

planeBDbSsmName.description: SSM Parameter Store path for Plane B database URL

planeCDbSecretArn.description: ARN of Secrets Manager secret for Plane C database credentials

planeCDbSecretJsonKey.description: JSON key in Plane C database secret (e.g., DATABASE_URL_PLANE_C)

planeCDbSsmName.description: SSM Parameter Store path for Plane C database URL

redisSecretArn.description: ARN of Secrets Manager secret for Redis credentials

redisSecretJsonKey.description: JSON key in Redis secret (e.g., REDIS_URL)

redisSsmName.description: SSM Parameter Store path for Redis URL

supabaseSecretArn.description: ARN of Secrets Manager secret for Supabase config (URL + keys)

devSharedSecretArn.description: Shared dev secret ARN for Supabase/Stripe/Redis (dev only)

supabaseSsmName.description: SSM Parameter Store path for Supabase config

stripeSecretArn.description: ARN of Secrets Manager secret for Stripe config

stripeSsmName.description: SSM Parameter Store path for Stripe config

communicationsSecretArn.description: ARN of Secrets Manager secret for alerts/newsletter/push configuration

sentrySecretArn.description: ARN of Secrets Manager secret for Sentry DSN

sentrySecretJsonKey.description: JSON key in Sentry secret (e.g., SENTRY_DSN)

oandaSecretArn.description: ARN of Secrets Manager secret for OANDA API key

oandaSsmName.description: SSM Parameter Store path for OANDA API key

proxyResidentialSecretArn.description: ARN of Secrets Manager secret for residential proxy credentials

proxyResidentialSecretJsonKey.description: JSON key in residential proxy secret

proxyResidentialSsmName.description: SSM Parameter Store path for residential proxy URL

proxyDatacenterSecretArn.description: ARN of Secrets Manager secret for datacenter proxy credentials

proxyDatacenterSecretJsonKey.description: JSON key in datacenter proxy secret

proxyDatacenterSsmName.description: SSM Parameter Store path for datacenter proxy URL

opsPauseRuleAllowlist.description: List of EventBridge rule suffixes to pause when ops pause is enabled (prod only)

purgeQueuesOnResume.description: Toggle queue purge during ops-resume. Defaults to true for dev/staging and false for prod.

purgeQueueAllowlist.description: List of queue name suffixes eligible for purge on resume (for example: ingest-fanout,gold-live).

devPaused.description: Pause dev ECS services and EventBridge schedules when true

devNightlyPauseEnabled.description: Dev-only: enable the nightly auto-pause schedule (default: false)

devNightlyPauseTimezone.description: Dev-only: timezone for the nightly auto-pause schedule (e.g., America/New_York)

devNightlyPauseCron.description: Dev-only: cron() expression for the nightly auto-pause schedule (e.g., cron(0 0 * * ? *))

devMorningResumeCron.description: Dev-only: cron() expression for the morning auto-resume schedule (e.g., cron(0 8 ? * MON-FRI *))

goldIndicesLookbackDays.description: Lookback window days for the gold indices job (GOLD_INDICES_LOOKBACK_DAYS override)

providerWeightWindowDays.description: Lookback window days for the provider-weighting job (PROVIDER_WEIGHT_WINDOW_DAYS override)

costGuardrailsCreateCur.description: Create CUR bucket/report (default: true in prod only)

costBudgetAmountUsd.description: Monthly USD budget threshold used for the CloudWatch cost budget

costAnomalyThresholdUsd.description: USD anomaly threshold used for Cost Anomaly Detection

planeBB2bMaxQueueDepth.description: Max allowed B2B sweep queue depth before backpressure disables scheduling

planeBFxRateRefreshServiceEnabled.description: Enable FX rate refresh ECS service

planeBFxRateRefreshDesiredCount.description: Desired count for FX rate refresh worker service

planeBIngestDesiredCount.description: Desired count for Plane B ingest service

planeBDisableTier1.description: Disable Tier 1 collection (treat USD corridors as Tier 2 cadence)

planeBB2cRefreshDesiredCount.description: Desired count for Plane B B2C refresh service

planeBQueueWorkerDesiredCount.description: Desired count for Plane B queue worker services

planeBQueueWorkerMaxCount.description: Max count for Plane B queue worker services

planeBIngestFanoutTier1DesiredCount.description: Desired count for Plane B ingest fanout tier 1 service

planeBIngestFanoutTier2DesiredCount.description: Desired count for Plane B ingest fanout tier 2 service

goldLiveDesiredCount.description: Desired count for Gold live worker service

planeBNotificationsDesiredCount.description: Desired count for Plane B notifications worker service

planeBOpsAlertsDesiredCount.description: Desired count for Plane B ops alerts worker service

planeCBaseUrl.description: Base URL for Plane C API

enableCloudFront.description: Enable CloudFront distribution for Plane A API

enableWaf.description: Enable WAF for Plane A API

enablePlaneAJwtAuth.description: Enable JWT authentication for Plane A

planeAJwtIssuer.description: JWT issuer URL for Plane A (e.g., Supabase auth URL)

planeAJwtAudiences.description: JWT audience values for Plane A

planeAAdminEmails.description: Admin email allowlist for Plane A

sesIdentityArns.description: SES identity ARNs for email sending

snsTopicArns.description: SNS topic ARNs for alert routing

planeACorsAllowedHeaders.description: CORS allowed headers for Plane A

planeACorsAllowedMethods.description: CORS allowed methods for Plane A

planeACorsAllowCredentials.description: CORS allow credentials flag for Plane A

frontendBaseUrl.description: Frontend base URL for billing/newsletter links

publicSupabaseUrl.description: Public Supabase project URL for frontend builds

publicSupabaseAnonKey.description: Public Supabase anon key for frontend builds

enablePlaneCIamAuth.description: Enable IAM authentication for Plane C

disablePlaneAExecuteEndpoint.description: Disable execute endpoint for Plane A

disablePlaneCExecuteEndpoint.description: Disable execute endpoint for Plane C

wafAllowListIps.description: List of IP addresses to allow in WAF

wafBlockListIps.description: List of IP addresses to block in WAF

wafStripeWebhookAllowListIps.description: List of IP addresses allowed to hit /api/v1/billing/webhook

wafAdminAllowListIps.description: List of IP addresses allowed to hit admin/ops/audit routes

planeAThrottleRate.description: Throttle rate for Plane A API (requests per second)

planeAThrottleBurst.description: Throttle burst for Plane A API

planeCThrottleRate.description: Throttle rate for Plane C API (requests per second)

planeCThrottleBurst.description: Throttle burst for Plane C API

pipelineConnectionArn.description: ARN of CodeStar Connections connection for CI/CD pipeline

pipelineRepoOwner.description: GitHub repository owner for CI/CD pipeline

pipelineRepoName.description: GitHub repository name for CI/CD pipeline

pipelineRepoBranch.description: GitHub repository branch for CI/CD pipeline

pipelineEnableDeploy.description: Enable deployment stage in CI/CD pipeline

enableGithubActionsOidc.description: Create GitHub Actions OIDC provider + deploy roles in this account

githubRepoOwner.description: GitHub repository owner for GitHub Actions OIDC roles

githubRepoName.description: GitHub repository name for GitHub Actions OIDC roles

githubActionsOidcProviderArn.description: Existing GitHub Actions OIDC provider ARN (if already created in the AWS account)

planeADomainName.description: Custom domain name for Plane A API (e.g., api.remit-scout.com)

planeACertificateArn.description: ACM certificate ARN for Plane A domain

planeAHostedZoneId.description: Route53 hosted zone ID for Plane A domain

planeAHostedZoneName.description: Route53 hosted zone name for Plane A domain

frontendDomainName.description: Custom domain name for frontend (e.g., remit-scout.com)

frontendCertificateArn.description: ACM certificate ARN for frontend domain

frontendHostedZoneId.description: Route53 hosted zone ID for frontend domain

frontendHostedZoneName.description: Route53 hosted zone name for frontend domain

slackWebhookUrl.description: Slack webhook URL for alert notifications

pagerDutyIntegrationKey.description: PagerDuty integration key for critical alerts
